text: Accepted GetPurgeThreshold reads a default 500 megabytes, multiplies by 1024 into its output, and AutoCompactEvent multiplies that output by 1024 before comparing expunged bytes. The default preference agrees with the fallback. These are binary conversions using 1024 at each boundary. Scoped naming/documentation recommendation: use explicit MB, KB and byte names when changing these boundaries. Do not compare the MB preference directly with totalExpungedBytes or silently change either conversion. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Track compaction threshold units through both conversions
